messages:
Emma (Sales): Heads up — Product Ops pushed the new pricing schedule to staging. It includes a small embedding price increase and new committed-throughput tiers. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/pricing-schedule :eyes:
Avery (AE): When does this go live to customers? Need to know for renewal talks next week.
Lin (Product Ops): Planning a soft rollout next Tue 2026-04-07 (internal). Public docs release Wed. We want to notify accounts with active commits 7 days before public.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Any perf/cost breakouts for typical POCs? Embeddings bump hits high-dim vectors hard. Can we show net impact for 1M tokens + 50k embeddings?
Carlos (Deal Desk): Also, we removed the old "founder" discount SKU. If anyone has legacy committments, we need to decide grandfathering rules.
Emma (Sales): Customer X has a renewal on Apr 12, locked on the old SKU. They asked for price certainty. Can we grandfather?
Omar (Finance): Need to follow the policy — grandfather for active contracts that explicitly reference SKU IDs and an end date after rollout. Exceptions need Deal Desk approval + finance sign-off.
Nia (Legal): Also check contract language re: "pricing schedule" vs "rate card" — some older contracts allow unilateral changes with notice; others require amendment. Send me contract clause and I'll confirm.
Avery (AE): Sending contract excerpt...
Avery (AE): ```
Section 4.2 - Pricing: Customer shall be charged per the then-current Pricing Schedule, provided 30 days' advance notice for changes.
```
Nia (Legal): Good — 30 days notice gives us wiggle room. If rollout is Apr 7 public, we should notify them by Mar 8 — but Product Ops plan is tight.
Lin (Product Ops): We can delay public release by 7 days for a limited set of enterprise accounts if Deal Desk flags them.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Ok. For exceptions, we need: 1) customer contract reference, 2) revenue impact estimate, 3) proposed effective date. Post those here and tag me. I can do triage within 24h.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Attached quick calc for Customer X: delta ~ +$1.2k/mo on embeddings at current usage, but if we migrate them to committed-tier "C2" it reduces bill to +$400/mo and offers latency guarantees. Recommend offering a 6-month commit credit to smooth the bump.
Emma (Sales): Perfect. I'll propose the C2 + 6mo credit. Carlos — can we preapprove a one-time concession up to $5k for renewals handled by AE?
Carlos (Deal Desk): Deal Desk policy: AEs can approve up to $2k. Anything above needs a formal exception from Deal Desk + Finance. Tag @Omar for sign-off.
Omar (Finance): I'm ok with up to $5k for strategic accounts with documented ROI/retention case. Need revenue waterfall and margin impact.
DealDeskBot: New exception request template: https://redwood.atlassian/ops/exception-template. Use the form and fill "pricing-impact".
Emma (Sales): Filing now. ETA 15m.
Emma (Sales): Filed. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/ops/exception/98765 (status: pending)
Carlos (Deal Desk): Received. @Omar @Nia I'll route to finance/legal. If both +1, we'll mark as grandfathered till end of original term and apply the 6mo credit.
Nia (Legal): Quick note — any communication to customers must include the official notice language. Use the template in Legal > Pricing Notices. I'll paste a short compliant blurb here in a sec.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For the POC teams: hold off provisioning the new committed-tier templates until we confirm the grandfathered list. Some infra configs differ between legacy and C2.
Lin (Product Ops): Noted. I'll gate the rollout for flagged accounts. We should also add a metrics dashboard showing customer-level impact so Sales can run sims quickly.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Action items: Emma — send contract and revenue impact (done). Priya — confirm migration steps and risk. Nia & Omar — pls sign or ask Qs. Lin — delay rollout for flagged accounts.
Emma (Sales): Thanks — will loop in the AE owner for Customer Y as well; they might request the same.
Avery (AE): FYI customer Y will take the 6mo credit. Good to know.
Omar (Finance): I'll review exception now, expect note in ~2 hours.
Nia (Legal): Reviewing and will approve language edits if the customer email matches the template.
Carlos (Deal Desk): If approved, I'll post the final list here and notify Product Ops to unblock those accounts.
Emma (Sales): Great, thanks all :rocket:
DealDeskBot: Exception 98765 status updated to APPROVED by Omar, Nia, Carlos at 1763200830.
